games.name: DON'T LET HIM IN [NEW MONSTER]
games.desc:
Work together to survive the night while it circles the house, studies your mistakes, and searches for a way in.

Keep the floodlights powered. Watch the doors and windows. Restore the breaker when the power fails. Light keeps it away, but one vulnerable entrance is all it needs.

If it gets inside, the house goes dark.

Hide. Stay quiet. Survive until morning.

📱🥽🎮 ALL DEVICES SUPPORTED

🎧 Headphones strongly recommended
🎙️ Best experienced with voice chat
🖼️ Highest quality graphics recommended

The Locust, Boiled One, and Boy and the Bath characters are all originally created by DoctorNowhere.

games.desc:
[EARLY ALPHA]

Enter the lower layers, recover samples, gather evidence, and make it back to HQ before things go wrong. Every run is different, and every item you bring back matters.

The game is still very early, so expect bugs, missing features, and rough edges. 
The game will be updated a lot over time with new content, new entities, new levels, better systems, more items, balancing changes, and general improvements.

If you enjoy extraction games, co-op horror, or the Backrooms, give it a try and help shape the game while it grows.

Inspired by The Backrooms from Kane Pixels and Lethal Company

Play the game, leave feedback, and report bugs.
More updates soon.
